manual_notes: Disabled-mode cleanup, configured markers, dry-run and --no-gitignore precedence are implemented. Strict no-op when no managed block exists is not guaranteed: remove_managed_section rebuilds every line with a newline, so an unmanaged file lacking a final newline (or using CRLF) differs and is rewritten/reported as cleanup despite having no managed section.
